subject: Author Jimmy Matejek-Morris and Forsooth Release
overview: Author Jimmy Matejek-Morris joined the podcast to discuss his background, his debut novel, and his upcoming young adult book, Forsooth.

items.title: Introduction and favorite eatery
items.summary: Author Jimmy Matejek-Morris introduced himself and identified Colleen's as his favorite place to eat in Medford.

items.title: Career background and debut novel
items.summary: The author described his journey from theater and film to children's literature and discussed how his first book, My Ex-Imaginary Friend, uses a part-walrus character to explore childhood mental health and family disappearance.

items.title: Creative supports and influences
items.summary: Matejek-Morris credited his husband with helping him overcome creative blocks and listed several queer young adult authors as his primary literary inspirations.

items.title: Discussion of new book Forsooth
items.summary: The discussion focused on the plot of his new novel, which follows a theater student navigating stage fright, resilience, and gay identity within a Catholic household.

items.title: Release information and upcoming events
items.summary: The author announced the November 7th release date for Forsooth and scheduled a book signing event at the Silver Unicorn for November 11th.
